how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-undercity-02-r2.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:4642:details:0: Here is some encased ooze created from the ⟦E4⟧ samples you recovered. Take the case to ⟦E5⟧ and find a pure ooze... the primal variety will do nicely. When you get close enough, release the ooze in the case, and let us see what the two think of one another.
rows.quest:4642:details:1: After the experiment concludes, bring me a sample of whatever is left over. I will await you here in the Apothecarium.
rows.quest:4642:progress:0: How goes the experiment, ⟦1⟧? I will continue to study the samples you've recovered for me--I am starting to see why Lady Sylvanas is so interested in these creatures. If they are truly part of the Old Gods, then who knows how it can be used to our benefit.
rows.quest:4642:completion:0: Oh, most excellent, ⟦2⟧. This is most excellent.
rows.quest:4642:completion:1: Such a tale. Who would have thought the two would interact with one another in such a way... I will have to spend more time looking at the environmental issues that cause changes in these creatures.
rows.quest:4642:completion:2: I will continue my research for now. Perhaps we will speak again soon. Until then, I wish you well.
rows.quest:4294:obj:0: Gather Un'Goro Slime Samples from any of the slimes in ⟦E5⟧. Then, using the ⟦E6⟧ next to ⟦E2⟧ in ⟦E3⟧, see which of your samples are the most pure. Bring 5 of the Pure Un'Goro Samples you find to ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:4294:details:0: Have you heard of the ⟦E5⟧, ⟦3⟧? It is near the ⟦E7⟧ desert, and it is a magnificent place: lush, vibrant, full of creatures and plant life.
rows.quest:4294:details:1: It is there you must go. Word has reached me that the place seems completely untainted by outside hands. Explorers are just now discovering its secrets.
rows.quest:4294:details:2: I would like to test the slimes or oozes there. If it is true--that they are uncorrupt--then I would like to see how such creatures have evolved.
rows.quest:4294:completion:0: Truly amazing, ⟦5⟧. This ⟦E5⟧ is holding many more secrets than I expected. I wonder what else we will discover as we test further.
rows.quest:4294:completion:1: Simply amazing... look at the purity of these samples. Hmm, I wonder what it could mean. They seem to be elemental in nature, but... something more. They remind me of... of the Old Gods. We've found traces of them throughout ⟦E8⟧, and now I wonder if these creatures aren't related to them somehow.
rows.quest:4294:completion:2: We shall have to test further.
rows.quest:5961:obj:0: Speak with ⟦E9⟧ in the ⟦E10⟧. He is said to have taken up residence at the Marris Stead.⟦6⟧
rows.quest:5961:details:0: It pleases me greatly to see the battle hardened join our cause. Our numbers grow in size and strength as each day passes. Perhaps you are prepared to test your mettle, ⟦7⟧?
rows.quest:5961:details:1: Among the first of my champions was ⟦E12⟧, now known as the Blightcaller. Few exist with more dedication or vigor amidst our ranks.
rows.quest:5961:details:2: Seek him out in the ⟦E10⟧. He resides at the Marris Stead; occasionally roaming the decimated wastes, slaying all Scourge and ⟦E13⟧ filth that cross his path.
rows.quest:5961:completion:0: Surely the Dark Lady does not believe you worthy to meet her champion. You are here to feed my hounds, yes? There could be no other reason for this interruption.
